decisions.reason: As an announced extension close to the core practice software and the firm's paperless digital-practice direction, management would likely continue to justify the investment absent clear failure signals.

Because the service builds on the firm's support capabilities and customer ties, management would tend to retain it, though it is somewhat easier than the software modules to absorb back into the broader service offering if needed.

As a newly launched module within the established suite, it benefits from recent development investment and from management's tendency to give strategically fitting add-ons more time before admitting disappointment.

This messaging service is visibly committed on its own page and closely tied to regulation-driven digital integration, so management would be especially inclined to persist and interpret any early weakness as temporary.
